tool_args.rationale: The slow-horizon probe reveals a sign reversal and supplies eight observations across short and long horizons. Fit all five parameters numerically to the recalled sink-coupled dual-horizon law and test it on fresh confirmation data.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot varies sink gradient and the recalled mechanism explicitly includes its effect; the uncoupled model cannot represent that dependence.
The short-window sink dependence and long-horizon reversal are more directly explained by the specified sink-coupled adaptation mechanism.
The acquired probe supplies three additional horizons, including observations near the target, for fitting the five-parameter mechanism.
